violations.text: Food items processed in establishment were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Establishment date marked items during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Eggs boxes were observed stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Eggs were moved to shelfing during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

Food items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Food was removed from the floor at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 11/27/2024
The ceiling tile in the dry storage/freezer area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 03/26/2025
